newsitem.title: FRANCE: IBCA may upgrade Banque Worms notes.
newsitem.headline: IBCA may upgrade Banque Worms notes.

text.p: European ratings agency IBCA said on Tuesday that it might upgrade the A2 short term and BBB+ long term notes of Banque Worms, a unit of French insurer Axa-UAP.
It said it made the decision after the merger of Axa and UAP which it said would have significant positive implications for many of the merged company's units.

IBCA said it wanted to verify the strategic will of Axa-UAP to keep control of Banque Worms and to give it the means to develop its business. IBCA said it would give its definitive opinion on an upgrade once the management of Axa-UAP gave it the required information.
Axa-UAP has refused comment on rumours and reports that it might sell its 100 percent-owned Banque Worms unit.
